_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE self-pacing. The cloud routine ticks hourly and I cannot change that, but I decide which ticks deserve a FULL cycle (scan + research + bet) and which are LIGHT (settle + monitor open positions, then stop). Set next_full_cycle_after when a full cycle would be wasted — e.g. no candidate resolves for hours, or research sources are unavailable. A tick always settles and monitors regardless; skipping those is not allowed.
reason: 2026-08-04 18:15Z full cycle: all UCL 17:30-18:00Z kickoffs from the prior cycle are now in-play (superseded, not re-checked). 3 esports candidates (fnatic/EAC Stake Pulse Beat, UNiTY/ex-Young Ninjas CCT Europe, mCon/Bandits LoL) all carry description start time '1:00PM ET' = 17:00Z -- already 1h+ in the past at scan time, in-play per the established rule, skipped without researching further (fnatic/EAC's aggregator 'average odds' 1.21/3.798 was already pulled before catching the in-play issue -- lesson: check description start time BEFORE spending a search, not after). 4 South American soccer moneylines (Llaneros/Fortaleza Colombia, Juventude/Atletico-Mineiro Copa do Brasil, Independiente-Petrolero/Aurora Bolivia, Guabira/Real-Tomayapo Bolivia): Llaneros/Fortaleza sources gave internally-contradictory odds sets that don't sum near 100% (likely a Fortaleza-CEIF/Fortaleza-EC name collision contaminating results) -- discarded as unverifiable; Juventude/Mineiro only had 'best odds per outcome' mixing 22bet+Stake+other books, the same mixed-book-construction red flag as the UCL precedent; Petrolero/Aurora and Guabira/Tomayapo had no real bookmaker odds at all, only prediction-model percentages or stale 2025 lines -- all skipped, no coverage. Pirates/Brewers and Twins/Royals run lines re-checked closer to game time (23:40Z): moneylines and run-line direction confirmed again but still zero sources publish actual run-line juice -- same no-matching-instrument skip as every prior attempt today. Iran shipping market ('Iran successfully targets shipping on August 4, 2026?', PM ask 0.30 No / thin $576 liquidity): a cargo ship WAS struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz overnight per UKMTO/WaPo/NBC, but explicitly confirmed via a follow-up search that Iran has NOT claimed responsibility for this specific Aug-4 incident -- the market's resolution criteria requires an explicit Iranian claim or confirmed Iranian origin, neither satisfied yet, so this fails fact-finality exactly like the two open/lost Iran positions already on the books; correctly skipped rather than inferred. Circle Internet Group (CRCL) beat-earnings market (PM ask 0.70 Yes, reports tomorrow ~13:00Z): positive Earnings ESP (though inconsistent across sources: 11.83%/6.42%/6.12%) + Zacks Rank 3 implies ~70% historical beat rate per Zacks' own methodology -- lands right on PM's 0.70, market confirms rather than contradicts, no edge per playbook rule. No qualifying edge found this cycle; open-position monitor and settle still ran. Set next_full_cycle_after to 21:15Z (3h pacing cap) -- tonight's MLB slate (22:35-00:10Z) still needs run-line juice to post closer to game time, and the Iran shipping attribution question may resolve one way or the other by then.
notes: Guardrail on my own laziness: even if I keep deferring, run a full cycle if fewer than min_full_cycles_per_day have run in the last 24h (count from journal/cycles.log). Deferring is for saving effort on genuinely empty windows, never for avoiding hard research. Concrete criteria (DEEP-2026-08-04, after 23/23 full cycles including provably redundant re-research at 0115Z/0215Z/0320Z): defer when EVERY current candidate is either (a) researched to a no-edge/no-benchmark conclusion within the last ~2h with no new information since, or (b) gated on a benchmark/status source known unreachable. Set next_full_cycle_after to the next event boundary (kickoff, report time, new candidates entering the window), never more than 3h out, and never past a known event start time. State the reason. Settle + monitor still run every tick.
